title: Eastern Highlights with Cruise – Balcony Stateroom
shortDescription: Get to know the lovely city of Singapore in your own preferred way. Take full day sightseeing options and explore the city by hopping on and off from city sightseeing bus at your favoured points.
description: Get to know the lovely city of Singapore in your own preferred way. Take full day sightseeing options and explore the city by hopping on and off from city sightseeing bus at your favoured points. Spend time at the Marina Bay, Esplanade and other parts of Singapore. In mid of your Singapore holiday, also take a super fun and luxurious trip on Dream Cruises, a luxurious cruise that will take you to exotic Islands.

highlights: 2 nights on Genting Dream in a Balcony stateroom
Half-day city tour with the Merlion and Little India
A free day for Universal Studios (optional)

itinerary.title: Arrive Singapore – Evening Free
itinerary.description: Optional - Singapore Flyer. Upon arrival at Singapore Airport, our local tour representative will meet you and transfer you to the hotel. Check-in (Standard Check-in time: 1400 - 1500 hours) and relax. Rest of the day is at your own leisure. Take a stroll through the city streets in the evening or we suggest you to opt for a ride on Singapore Flyer (at extra cost), the highest observatory wheel in the world. It is a unique and extra ordinary experience to take majestic city views from up above in the luxurious glass cubicle.

itinerary.title: Singapore City tour – Day Free
itinerary.description: Optional - Night Safari. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at hotel. Later set out for a City tour. Drive round the Central Business District passing the Cricket Club, Parliament house, Supreme Court, etc. See the glorified Orchard Road with its best brand showrooms. Visit the enchanting China Town and get awed with the dazzling gems at the Gem Gallery. Then we visit Marina Bay, the most clicked Singapore’s landmark. The sheer exuberance of the area will leave you open jawed. See the majestic Marina Bay Sands and the ‘wonder’ful architecture of the Esplanade and how can you miss the Lion while being at the Lion City! Yes. Click great pictures in front of the Merlion. We also visit Little India, to make you feel at home!

itinerary.title: Singapore – Onboard Cruise
itinerary.description: You can enjoy a cozy morning time in your bed as you have a relaxed morning today. Have a fill at morning breakfast and check out from the hotel by 1200 hrs. Enjoy leisure time in Singapore exploring nearby places until your pick up from Hotel Lobby for Cruise terminal to board your cruise. Boarding starts 4 hours prior to departure. After a warm welcome on board, explore and enjoy the various facilities offered. Stay overnight onboard Cruise.

itinerary.title: Onboard Cruise
itinerary.description: Wake up to an exotic morning over the seas. Enjoy a bed tea while taking stunning sea views. The beauty of sunrise on sea is incredible. Refresh and enjoy a wide spread of breakfast on board. (Note: Your sailing routes depend on your departure dates) Onboard, you can enjoy various entertainment activities, shopping and dining at in-house restaurants. Stay overnight onboard Cruise.

itinerary.title: Disembark from Cruise – Day Free
itinerary.description: Enjoy another beautiful morning over the deep seas. Relish wide spread breakfast and enjoy the aura for a while longer before going back to the land. On your return to Singapore, disembark from the cruise and meet our local tour representative for your transfer to hotel. Check-in and relax. Rest of the day is free at your own leisure. It can take a while to get back to the feeling of being on land. We suggest you to take rest today. In evening however if you feel like, you can step out to take leisurely strolls and relish some local delicacies.

itinerary.title: Full day Free for Leisure
itinerary.description: Optional - Universal Studio tour. Enjoy morning breakfast at length as you have the day at leisure. You can go to explore the city attractions on your own or you may join us for an exciting day at Universal Studios (at extra cost). South East Asia’s first Hollywood movie theme park with seven zones including Jurassic Park, Shrek, Sci-Fi City, New York, Hollywood, Madagascar and Ancient Egypt, Universal Studios is a fantastic world of movie magic. With numerous rides and attractions based on Hollywood blockbusters, it is a great day out for all ages. Revel in the glamour of showbiz while taking nerve tickling and jaw dropping rides like Battlestar Galactica, Accelerator, Revenge of the Mummy, Canopy Flyer, Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure, Enchanted Airways etc. Swirl through exciting loops and sudden turns of roller coasters and don’t miss the Magic Potion Spin that will make your lungs scream out. After experiencing the extreme stage of adrenaline rush, calm yourself with house entertainment at Waterworld, Shrek 4D Adventure, Donkey Live and Light, Camera and Action, etc. Head for a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant and later return to hotel and retire to sleep.

itinerary.title: Singapore – Departure
itinerary.description: Morning have a fill at breakfast, pack your bags and check out from the hotel. Today your vacation at Singapore ends and you get transferred to airport for your flight back home.
